_about: Platform email design values. Neutral: no publisher, no INBXIFY brand. Names match web-blocks-v31.css. '@name' means the value of that name. v2 = v1 + EV (Design Port S3, EV review v0.1). v3 = v2 + ev-meta-size, the EV time-and-venue line, which no longer shares the 10px label role. v4 = v3 + TXA (TXA review v0.1). txa-frame-bg changes from @accent-soft, the old gold field, to @cream. v5 = v4 + the three EV phone values the shell's media query reads. v6 = v5 with ev-title-lh-m tightened from 1.18 to 1.08 (phone, wrapped titles). v7 = v6 + the TXA card mark, which replaces the customer logo. v8 = v7 + RE, for the editorial list (email-re-listing-v2). v9 = v8 + the Email Pass (Design Pass 2 S4): column and paper, tiles, the three openers, flag, story link, group panels (read by newsletter-render v1.12.0), section-art size, one banner width, weather strip, phone sizes. split-headline-size 23 -> 27 (D173). page-bg follows web's platform page colour. v10 = v9 + weather settings read by newsletter-render v1.13.0 (unit, days, phone days) and the house ads (email-ba-house-left/right/center-v1): each kind (subscribe, advertise, bookmark) has its edge colour, the colour on it, the drawing ground, and the picture addresses (title files supply the pictures). Shape and sizes are platform. v11 = v10 + house-ad button defaults, read by newsletter-render v1.13.1 when the ADS record has no House Button Link or Text: ha-<kind>-href is a link pattern, {key} filled from the context (publisherEmail = PUBLISHERS business-email, titleName); ha-<kind>-button is the default words. Subscribe has no default link yet (pending a ruling). v12 = v11 + Subscribe's default link: the issue's web page with ?subscribe=true, which opens the site's subscribe popup (needs newsletter-render v1.13.2 for {&key}). v13 = v12 + required-context (newsletter-render v1.14.0): context values every email needs. If one is empty the Worker answers 422 and renders nothing, so a missing field stops the run instead of printing a blank. v14 = v13 + ogImage in required-context: 206 v1.36 sends ogImage (the first FA story's picture, by position) and an issue without one stops the run (Clean-Up S1). v15 = v14 + the Bookmark how-to (Clean-Up S1): Bookmark's default link is the issue page with ?bookmark=true, which opens the how-to panel (body.js 1.14, section 19); ha-bookmark-howto-* are the panel's words, copied to ha-howto-* for a Bookmark house ad. Web templates web-ha-*-v5 draw the panel. v16 = v15 + publisherName, publisherPerson and publisherPhone in required-context (M11, Clean-Up S1): 206 v1.40 sends the contact name and phone from PUBLISHERS (Contact Name, Business Phone) with no fallback, so a publisher without them stops the run. v17 = v16 + the splash page colours (Clean-Up S2, HC-P-CU1-4): splash-bg, splash-accent, splash-ink, splash-tile-bg and splash-tile-border, read by the Data Worker's /splash (v1.0.6) for splash v3.5. Each defaults to the title's own colours, so a title with no splash values gets its brand on the splash. A title file may set any of them. v18 = v17 + the splash times (Clean-Up S2): splash-ms is the whole splash when there is an ad (6960, today's time) and splash-ms-no-ad when there is none (3000). Whole milliseconds, 1000 to 20000. A link's dur= still wins. v19 = v18 + the title layer (Title Design S1, 26 Oct 2026; title fields review v0.1, every row accepted). A title's twelve design values now come from its TITLES record (render Worker v1.22.0, Data Worker v1.0.87), not from a title token file. This file holds the platform recipes that mix every other shade from those twelve: mix(a, b, p) is a with p% of b. The percentages are platform values, one for every title. Also new: accent-2 (Second Accent), accent-text, end-bg/end-ink/end-ink-soft (Footer Color), logo-on-main, signoff-role, signoff-default (G5), the font fallbacks, weights and the Google Fonts extra (Spectral, F4), and web-vars (the names the platform web shell writes as --nl-* variables). WLN's choices that were references, not colours, become platform: the event chip is Accent with Main ink, the Spotlights ink is Main, The Find card name is Spectral, art heights 52px / 220px / 180px (G9). v20 (Franchise Bands S2, 30 Oct 2026) = v19 + the franchise band sizes for Feature Article and Themed Spotlight blocks (Mockup 1, accepted). Email: band-badge (the round mascot badge), band-badge-img (the mascot inside it), band-gap (badge to words), band-words-h (the wordmark's height; newsletter-render v1.23.0 works out its width from the image's own size), band-words-max (the widest a wordmark may draw), band-name-size (the name in words when there is no wordmark). Web: the same three sizes for desktop and phone, written as --nl-band-* variables through web-vars. Every title reads these; nothing title-specific. Without them, render v1.23.0 draws no band and the story keeps its small art. v21 (Franchise Bands S2, 30 Oct 2026) = v20 + the Accent mark (accent-mark-w, accent-mark-h: a short line in Accent, 52 by 2, centred at the top of a story whose franchise has no mascot and no section art, General today). Bare numbers: email prints them as pixels, the web shell writes them as --nl-accent-mark-w/-h (the CSS multiplies by 1px).
_fonts: ----- web-safe chains only, so a title with no file still gets fonts every client has
_type: ----- the eleven roles; email's own number: t-body 16 (web 15)
_elements: ----- per-element names (web's where web has one) and email's own mappings
_phone: ----- read by the shell's phone rules (Outlook ignores them); today's values, item S-phone rejected
_ev: ----- EV (D28). Chip line heights in email-ev-cards-v4 are tuned to these chip sizes (HC-039).
_re: ----- RE · On the Market (the editorial list)
_story: ----- v9 · story pieces (D163, D164, D173, D178)
_groups: ----- v9 · group panels (D170), read by newsletter-render v1.12.0. Tints are percent of the edge on white.
_weather: ----- v9 · weather strip (kept from the legacy email, L1)
_phone_v9: ----- v9 · phone sizes, kept in proportion to desktop (E2)
_weather_v10: ----- v10 · weather data (newsletter-render v1.13.0). Unit fahrenheit or celsius.
_house: ----- v10 · house ads (D146). The Worker copies ha-<kind>-<name> to ha-<name> for the block.

_splash: ----- v17 · the splash page (splash v3.5, Data Worker v1.0.6). Background, the rule and label colour, the words on the background, and the ad tile.
_splash_time: ----- v18 · splash times in milliseconds (splash v3.6, Data Worker v1.0.7). A title file may set either.
_title: ----- v19 · the title layer. TITLES sets ink, accent, highlight, paper, text, accent-2, end-bg, the three fonts, logo-on-main and signoff-role; the values below are the platform defaults a title never sees once its record is filled.
